thread:
claire: Quick sync on page copy + routing for launch posts and webinar signups. Need clear CTAs for Hosted, Dedicated, Private. Keep hero short.
noah: Draft hero options: A) "Predictable inference at production scale." B) "One API. Any deployment." C) "Ship LLM features, skip the infra."
anya: A resonates with benchmarks audience; B is good for docs linking. Recommend A on main page, B in secondary header.
samira: Webinar date Nov 12 10am PT. CTA primary: "Register: Benchmark Deep Dive" secondary: "Start hosted trial". For ?mode=dedicated flip secondary to "Request reserved capacity". For ?aud=enterprise flip primary to "Request demo".
claire: UTMs: utm_campaign=nov_bench, utm_source=launchpost, utm_content=hosted|dedicated|private. Marketing ops will make mapping sheet.
noah: Microcopy under hero: three cards: Performance (12-15 words), Cost (12-15 words), Deployments (12-15 words). Drafts: Performance: "P95 latency and autoscale for production LLM flows." Cost: "Lower unit cost via batching, caching and quantization guidance." Deployments: "Same API across hosted, reserved, and private VPCs."
anya: Slight tweak: Deployments -> "One API, multiple deployments: hosted, dedicated, or private VPC."
claire: Routing pseudocode for handoff: 
```
if (params.aud === 'enterprise' || params.mode === 'private') routeTo('enterprise_queue');
else if (params.mode === 'dedicated') routeTo('ae_dedicated');
else routeTo('marketing_self_serve');
```
Include hidden fields in webinar form: utm_campaign, mode, est_monthly_tokens, compliance_interest.
marketing-bot: Assets uploaded: https://assets.redwood.com/launch/benchmarks (graphs + social cards).
claire: Next: noah finalize hero + card blurbs by EOD Tue; anya finalize FAQ and tone; samira build webinar form and email flows; I'll review Wed 9am PT. Keep replies short.
